project: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gundam vs. Gundam NEXT PLUS Korean fan translation

public_korean_only_draft.note: The 2026-09-25 map and mission drafts are local-only for now; the public exporter only accepts EBOOT_05-digit IDs.

observations: MISSION 1 title and both description lines render in Korean, together with the map label, mode description and help panels.
The main menu description changed from '인 협력 플레이도 …' to '두 명이 협력 플레이…', confirming Hangul numerals render where digits did not.

known_issue: Only Hangul syllables (U+AC00..U+D7A3) render through the replaced text decoder. Half-width ASCII (U+0021..U+007E) and full-width Latin (U+FF12 tested) both draw nothing, with no advance. ASCII bytes do reach the decoder and the cursor advance is correct; delegating the byte to the game's own code-table routine (0x089BC598) also draws nothing. The remaining question is which code the renderer accepts for digits and letters.

notation_policy.digits: written as Hangul numerals because digits do not render (e.g. 육십초, 두 기)
notation_policy.digits_left_alone: names, model numbers and era designations such as F91, V2, Mk-II, 제08MS소대, 사이드 7, 우주세기 0079, 기동전사 건담 0080
